name: ST7789V MADCTL (36h)
desc: MIPI DCS set_address_mode. Written as command byte 0x36 (i8080 command port 0x12000000) followed by one parameter byte (data port 0x12000004). The address here is only a placeholder; wire_addr is the command opcode.

registers.name: MADCTL
registers.desc: Memory data access control: frame-memory read/write scan direction and the RGB/BGR order. Stock writes 0xC0 (MY|MX: rows and columns both reversed, i.e. the frame rotated 180 degrees, RGB order) when the user's display-direction setting bit is 0 (the default on a blank configuration), and 0x00 when it is 1. Default 00h after power-on and H/W reset, unchanged by S/W reset (HX8353E p.150; ST7789V p.217). Read back with RDDMADCTL (0Bh). CAUTION: LCMCTRL (C0h) parameter XORs MY, BGR, MX, MV and others into this register; stock writes C0h = 0x2C (= the ST7789V default), whose set bits are XBGR, XMX and XMV (ST7789V 9.2.10, p.275). How that combines with this value on the real panel has not been measured.
registers.ds_value: 00h (power-on and H/W reset), no change on S/W reset
registers.fw_writes: 0x030178ec lcd_set_orientation: 0xC0 (argument 0) or 0x00 (argument != 0); called from 0x03017df8 (panel init) and 0x0304fdf8 (display-direction menu)

fields.name: RSVD
fields.desc: Unused (shown as '-'; HX8353E sets D1:D0 to 00 internally). Stock: 0.

fields.name: MH
fields.desc: Display data latch order (horizontal refresh): 0 = LCD refresh left to right, 1 = right to left. HX8353E names this bit SS, horizontal order (same position). Stock: 0.

fields.name: RGB
fields.desc: RGB/BGR order: 0 = RGB, 1 = BGR. HX8353E names this bit BGR (same position, same meaning). LCMCTRL XBGR XORs it. Stock: 0.

fields.name: ML
fields.desc: Vertical (line) refresh order of the panel: 0 = top to bottom, 1 = bottom to top. Affects refresh, not memory addressing. Stock: 0.

fields.name: MV
fields.desc: Page/column exchange (row/column swap): 0 = normal, 1 = reverse. Stock: 0 (never swaps; the frame is always addressed 240 wide x 320 tall).

fields.name: MX
fields.desc: Column address order: 0 = left to right, 1 = right to left. Stock: 1 (direction setting 0) or 0.

fields.name: MY
fields.desc: Page (row) address order: 0 = top to bottom, 1 = bottom to top. See HX8353E 6.2.1 / ST7789V 8.12 for the MCU-to-memory direction tables. Stock: 1 (direction setting 0) or 0.
